data.gender_notes: Krunal is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Krura’, meaning ‘crown’ or ‘rule’, Krunal is a powerful and regal name. In Hindu mythology, Krunal is the name of various gods and goddesses, each embodying different aspects of power and rule. The name Krunal carries the meaning “Crown, Rule” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Krunal usually hope their child will grow to embody crown, rule and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Krunal is associated with royalty and power in Hindu culture. It is believed that those bearing this name possess strong leadership qualities and have the ability to command respect and ignite a sense of hierarchy. In Indian folklore, there exists a popular character named Karna from the Mahabharata, who is known for his superior command over the army and unwavering loyalty, symbolizing the epitome of bravery and honor. This name has been passed down generations as a mark of pride and prestige.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Krunal signifies being a ruler of one's inner realm. It encourages one to rule their mind, emotions, and desires, thereby achieving mastery over their thoughts and actions. It suggests that the bearer of this name is a learned and wise individual capable of imparting wisdom to others. Furthermore, in Hindu beliefs, Krunal is often associated with Lord Shiva, the God of destruction and transformation, welcoming personal growth and transformation in the one who bears this name.
